user.title: Set up Statistics Curator
user.description: Statistics Curator watches registry changes so it can safely settle orphaned long-term statistics. Confirm to enable it.

init.title: Statistics Curator options
init.description: Saving changes reloads Statistics Curator before the new policy takes effect.

data_description.clear_disabled: Clear orphaned statistics when their entity still exists but is disabled. This house rule is enabled by default.
data_description.migrate_successors: Move history only when the removed entity's exact domain, platform, and unique ID reappear under a new entity ID.
data_description.clear_deleted: Clear statistics only when this integration witnessed the entity's removal and its recorded device no longer exists.
data_description.clear_unwitnessed: Clear statistics whose removal was never observed. This is unsafe by default because nothing proves the original device is gone.
data_description.debounce_seconds: Delay after Spook raises its orphaned-statistics repair before acting. Set 0 to act immediately.
data_description.dismiss_spook_issue: After a clean pass, reload Spook so it can retire its repair. Disable this to leave the repair open.

abort.not_loaded: Statistics Curator is not loaded. Reload the integration and try again.

confirm.title: Clear the mixed statistics
confirm.description:
`{statistic_id}` belonged to `{platform}` / `{unique_id}`, which was removed, and a different entity later took that id. Rows are bucketed, so the two devices' data share at least the bucket that was open at the removal: this history can no longer be attributed to either of them and will not be migrated or cleared automatically.

Submit to clear every long-term and 5-minute statistic under `{statistic_id}`. This cannot be undone. (Clearing it from Settings → Tools → Statistics instead also works; this repair goes away within the hour.)

curate.name: Curate orphaned statistics
curate.description: Settle long-term statistics with no live entity, then let Spook re-check.

clear_unwitnessed.name: Clear unwitnessed orphans
clear_unwitnessed.description: Also clear orphans whose removal this integration did not see.
